sentences.en: Words fail me to describe the beauty of this landscape.
sentences.zh: 我无法用言语来描述这片风景的美丽。

sentences.en: A dreary landscape spread out for miles in all directions.
sentences.zh: 眼前是一片绵延不绝的灰暗景色。

sentences.en: The landscape was a measureless yellow mass of flourishing sunflowers.
sentences.zh: 那里的风景是一片无边无际的盛开向日葵的黄色海洋。
